SELECT
  f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  a.STREET_NUMBER,
  a.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
  a.STREET_NAME,
  a.STREET_SUFFIX,
  a.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  o.DLC_NAME,
  a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
  f.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS BUILDING_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  a.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS ADDRESS_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fclt_building f
JOIN fclt_building_address a
  ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN fclt_organization o
  ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = o.DLC_KEY OR f.COST_CENTER_CODE = o.DLC_KEY OR o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
WHERE LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

     NULL AS ADDRESS_LINE_1,
     NULL AS ADDRESS_LINE_2,
     NULL AS CITY,
     NULL AS STATE_PROVINCE,
     NULL AS POSTAL_CODE,
     NULL AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
     NULL AS IS_ACTIVE,
     NULL AS VALID_FROM_DATE,
     NULL AS VALID_THRU_DATE

SELECT
  subject_iap_schedule.TERM_CODE,
  subject_iap_schedule.SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_iap_schedule.SESSION_NUMBER,
  subject_iap_schedule.MEET_PLACE,
  subject_iap_schedule.MEET_START_TIME,
  subject_iap_schedule.MEET_END_TIME,
  subject_iap_schedule.IAP_DAY,
  subject_iap_schedule.IAP_DATE,
  subject_iap_schedule.REMARKS,
  subject_iap_schedule.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- include subject_enrollable to get SUBJECT_TITLE / OFFER_DEPT_CODE which may link to subject/building info
  subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_TITLE_LONG,
  subject_enrollable.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_enrollable.ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_enrollable.CLUSTER_LIST,
  subject_enrollable.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  subject_enrollable.OFFER_SCHOOL_CODE,
  subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID,
  subject_enrollable.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- include space_detail to capture building/room keys and room info for physical locations
  space_detail.BUILDING_KEY,
  space_detail.FLOOR_KEY,
  space_detail.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
  space_detail.SPACE_USAGE_KEY,
  space_detail.BUILDING_ROOM,
  space_detail.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME,
  space_detail.ROOM_NUMBER,
  space_detail.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  space_detail.ROOM_COUNTER,
  space_detail.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  space_detail.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SPACE_DETAIL_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- include space_unit / space_unit2 for possible building/space unit names or codes
  space_unit.SPACE_UNIT,
  space_unit.SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
  space_unit.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  space_unit.DLC_KEY AS SPACE_UNIT_DLC_KEY,
  space_unit.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SPACE_UNIT_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  space_unit2.SPACE_UNIT AS SPACE_UNIT2_NAME,
  space_unit2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS SPACE_UNIT2_CODE,
  space_unit2.DLC_KEY AS SPACE_UNIT2_DLC_KEY,
  space_unit2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SPACE_UNIT2_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- include space_floor to get FLOOR / FLOOR_NAME
  space_floor.FLOOR,
  space_floor.FLOOR_NAME,
  space_floor.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SPACE_FLOOR_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- include sis_course_description in case fees are stored/related via COURSE or CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
  sis_course_description.COURSE,
  sis_course_description.COURSE_DESCRIPTION,
  sis_course_description.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG,
  sis_course_description.DEPARTMENT,
  sis_course_description.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sis_course_description.COURSE_LEVEL,
  sis_course_description.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE,
  sis_course_description.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- include sis_subject_code for department/subject metadata
  sis_subject_code.SUBJECT_CODE,
  sis_subject_code.COURSE_NUMBER,
  sis_subject_code.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sis_subject_code.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SIS_SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME,
  sis_subject_code.SCHOOL_CODE,
  sis_subject_code.SCHOOL_NAME AS SIS_SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME,
  sis_subject_code.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SIS_SUBJECT_CODE_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- include sis_lookup as possible indicator of IAP or location type
  sis_lookup.LOOKUP_TYPE,
  sis_lookup.CODE,
  sis_lookup.DESCRIPTION,
  sis_lookup.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SIS_LOOKUP_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM subject_iap_schedule
LEFT JOIN subject_enrollable
  ON subject_iap_schedule.TERM_CODE = subject_enrollable.TERM_CODE
  AND subject_iap_schedule.SUBJECT_ID = subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN space_detail
  ON subject_iap_schedule.MEET_PLACE = space_detail.BUILDING_ROOM
LEFT JOIN space_unit
  ON space_detail.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = space_unit.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
LEFT JOIN space_unit2
  ON space_detail.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = space_unit2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
LEFT JOIN space_floor
  ON space_detail.FLOOR_KEY = space_floor.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN sis_course_description
  ON subject_enrollable.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = sis_course_description.COURSE
LEFT JOIN sis_subject_code
  ON subject_iap_schedule.SUBJECT_ID = sis_subject_code.SUBJECT_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_lookup
  ON subject_iap_schedule.REMARKS = sis_lookup.CODE

  SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees,
  -- total building height: sum ROOM_COUNTER as a proxy for building height (available in this chunk as ROOM_COUNTER)

chunk_view_4_54.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- department identifier/name from subject_offered / tip_subject_offered / subject_summary variants
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  -- TIP subject type: use TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS if available via TIP detail/status
  -- count distinct TIP subject type per department (from tip_material_status linked via tip_detail)
  COUNT(DISTINCT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_tip_subject_types,
  -- total number of enrolled students for the department (from tip_subject_offered if present, fall back to subject_offered)
  SUM(COALESCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS total_enrolled_students,
  -- min and max rental new price from tip_material, excluding NULLs
  MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
  MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price,
  -- keep keys for later joins
  so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS offer_dept_code,
  so.TERM_CODE AS term_code
FROM subject_offered so
  -- TIP subject offered rows (may be NULL if no TIP data for a subject_offered row)
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
    ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  -- TIP detail links TIP subjects to materials and statuses
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    AND td.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
    AND td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID
  -- TIP material status (provides TIP subject type/status)
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  -- TIP material (provides rental prices)
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
WHERE
  -- only consider rows associated with a department (exclude missing department association)
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, so.TERM_CODE

SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE,
  -- derive human-readable description from TERM_CODE 'YYYYTT' -> 'Name YYYY'
  CONCAT(
    CASE RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE,2)
      WHEN 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
      WHEN 'JA' THEN 'IAP'
      WHEN 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
      WHEN 'SU' THEN 'Summer'
      ELSE RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE,2)
    END,
    ' ',
    LEFT(at.TERM_CODE,4)
  ) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  -- count distinct course types for courses whose DEPARTMENT_CODE = 'CIS' in this term
  COUNT(DISTINCT cc.GRADE_TYPE) AS TOTAL_CIS_COURSE_TYPES,
  -- include keys so this CTE can be joined later
  at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY
FROM academic_terms AS at
LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog AS cc
  ON cc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  AND cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 'CIS'
GROUP BY
  at.TERM_CODE,
  TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY

SELECT
  sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS room_full_name,
  sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_name,
  sf.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  se.ORGANIZATION AS occupying_organization,
  sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS occupying_department,
  sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE / NULLIF(floor_totals.floor_total_sqft,0) * 100 AS room_area_over_floor_area_percent,
  sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE / NULLIF(building_totals.building_total_sqft,0) * 100 AS room_area_over_building_area_percent,
  sd.BUILDING_KEY,
  sd.FLOOR_KEY,
  sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
  sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY,
  sd.ROOM_NUMBER,
  sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM space_detail sd
LEFT JOIN space_floor sf
  ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- per-floor totals (sum of ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE for that floor)
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS floor_total_sqft
  FROM space_detail
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY
) AS floor_totals
  ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = floor_totals.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- per-building totals (sum of ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE for that building)
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS building_total_sqft
  FROM space_detail
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS building_totals
  ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = building_totals.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN se_person se
  ON sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT = se.ORGANIZATION
WHERE
  sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NOT NULL
  AND floor_totals.floor_total_sqft IS NOT NULL
  AND building_totals.building_total_sqft IS NOT NULL
  AND sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT IS NOT NULL
  AND se.ORGANIZATION IS NOT NULL
  -- Exclude non-room spaces: require ROOM_NUMBER to be present
  AND sd.ROOM_NUMBER IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
  -- street address lines: concatenate street number, prefix, name, suffix, post directional where ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(
    COALESCE(a.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
    CASE WHEN a.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND a.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(a.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
    CASE WHEN (a.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL OR a.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL) AND a.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(a.STREET_NAME, ''),
    CASE WHEN a.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(a.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
    CASE WHEN a.POST_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(a.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
  ) SEPARATOR '; ') AS street_address,
  -- city/state/postal from address rows (use GROUP_CONCAT in case multiple)
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.CITY SEPARATOR '; ') AS city,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.STATE SEPARATOR '; ') AS state,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.POSTAL_CODE SEPARATOR '; ') AS postal_code,
  -- gross and assignable sqft from building
  b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS gross_square_footage,
  b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS assignable_square_footage,
  -- smallest and largest floor per building from fac_floor (FLOOR may be non-numeric, return as text min/max)
  MIN(f.FLOOR) AS smallest_floor_level,
  MAX(f.FLOOR) AS largest_floor_level,
  -- total area of all rooms for the building from fac_rooms
  SUM(r.AREA) AS total_room_area
FROM fac_building b
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN fac_floor f
  ON f.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  b.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA

  fp.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  -- course-level counts: distinct course offerings in reserve detail linked to this status+term
  COUNT(DISTINCT lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_courses,
  -- material-level counts: distinct reserve catalog items linked to this status+term
  COUNT(DISTINCT lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_materials,
  -- occurrences in departments: count of non-null OFFER_DEPT_NAME occurrences from subject_offered for these courses
  SUM(CASE WHEN lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occurrences_in_departments,
  -- occurrences in school: count of non-null OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME occurrences from subject_offered for these courses
  SUM(CASE WHEN lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occurrences_in_school,
  -- distinct instructors teaching the courses/materials for this status+term (from course_instructor)
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS total_distinct_instructors
FROM library_material_status lms
JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
  ON lmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  AND lmd.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN frc_fiscal_periods fp
  ON fp.FISCAL_PERIOD = lmd.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
WHERE lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND lmd.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lmd.TERM_CODE,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  fp.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION

chunk_view_2_163.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- department identifying fields (from library_course_instructor.DEPARTMENT and library_reserve_matrl_detail may link to subject/department)
  lci.DEPARTMENT AS department_name,
  -- TIP material fields available in this chunk: use library_reserve_catalog for title/author/isbn and catalog/system numbers
  lrc.CATALOG_TITLE AS tip_title,
  lrc.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME AS author,
  lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS isbn,
  -- library term code comes from library_reserve_matrl_detail
  lrm.TERM_CODE AS library_term_code,
  -- availability indicator: presence of a library_material_status key in the reserve detail joined to library_material_status table;
  -- we output text label mapping based on existence/Library material status code
  CASE
    WHEN lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
         AND lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE) <> '' THEN 'Available in Library'
    ELSE 'Not Available in Library'
  END AS library_availability,
  -- number of distinct instructors associated with this library book (library_reserve_catalog_key) within the department
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS instructors_per_library_book,
  -- count of materials (TIP records) associated with the department that are marked available in the library.
  -- This is computed by grouping by department below; here we include the per-department count as computed via window function.
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
           AND lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE IS NOT NULL
           AND TRIM(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE) <> '' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) OVER (PARTITION BY lci.DEPARTMENT) AS materials_available_in_library_for_department,
  -- total available materials across all departments (same value repeated for every row)
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
           AND lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE IS NOT NULL
           AND TRIM(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE) <> '' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) OVER () AS total_available_materials_all_departments,
  -- keep keys for later joins
  lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
  lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  lrm.TERM_CODE,
  lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
-- join to catalog to get title/author/isbn
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
  ON lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
-- join to material status to determine availability flag/text
LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
  ON lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
-- join to course_instructor to get instructor names and department; instructors link to catalog via LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY and/or subject_offered via LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
WHERE
  -- ensure the TIP material is associated with a department: require a department value from course_instructor (per filter rule)
  lci.DEPARTMENT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  lci.DEPARTMENT,
  lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
  lrc.CATALOG_TITLE,
  lrc.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME,
  lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,
  lrm.TERM_CODE,
  lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY

  CASE

    WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'

SELECT
  sip.PERSON_ROLE,
  sc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  /* distinct count of people per PERSON_ROLE + IAP_CATEGORY_NAME */
  COUNT(DISTINCT sip.PERSON_NAME) AS distinct_person_count,
  /* average fee from iap_subject_detail for the matching TERM_CODE and category key */
  AVG(CAST(sd.FEE AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS average_fee
FROM
  iap_subject_person sip
  /* iap_subject_detail links persons to categories via IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY and IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY */
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail sd
    ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = sip.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
  /* bring category name */
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_category sc
    ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = sc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
GROUP BY
  sip.PERSON_ROLE,
  sc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY
  distinct_person_count DESC
